import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0083 {α : Type} {β : Type} (l₁ : List α) (l₂ : List β) (h : l₁.length = l₂.length) :
  List.map Prod.fst (l₁.zip l₂) = l₁ := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0083 {α : Type} {β : Type} (l₁ : List α) (l₂ : List β) (h : l₁.length = l₂.length) :
  List.map Prod.fst (l₁.zip l₂) = l₁ :=
  by
    rw [List.map_zipWith, List.zipWith_fst, List.zipWith_congr, h, List.map_id]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0083 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0083 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0083

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0083
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0083
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
